# decision-003: Provide Telethon as an optional media backend that obtains direct video replies from a configured Telegram downloader bot and still uses the shared local validation/library path.

- Status: `superseded`

- Scope: merged into main by pull-request-13 at 5192e44 Historical snapshot as recorded 2026-10-16. Preserve dated implementation details here; successor decision restates only the durable core contract.

## Rationale and consequences

The backend is optional and isolated behind the userbot extra. It does not use yt-dlp or YouTube cookies. Returned media is untrusted and must pass size, FFprobe, and full-decode validation before library publication.
